title: Take Gifts From the Richest Pile
statement: Repeatedly replace the largest pile with its integer square root.
approach_name: Use a max-heap for repeated largest-pile updates

title: Take Gifts From the Richest Pile
statement: Repeatedly replace the largest pile with its integer square root.
approach_name: Use a max-heap for repeated largest-pile updates
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public long pickGifts(int[] gifts,int k){PriorityQueue<Integer> q=new PriorityQueue<>(Collections.reverseOrder());for(int x:gifts)q.offer(x);for(int i=0;i<k;i++){int x=q.poll();q.offer((int)Math.sqrt(x));}long sum=0;while(!q.isEmpty())sum+=q.poll();return sum;} }

title: Find the Array Concatenation Value
statement: Concatenate the outermost numbers and move inward.
approach_name: Concatenate outer pairs and add their numeric values
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public long findTheArrayConcVal(int[] nums){int i=0,j=nums.length-1;long ans=0;while(i<j){ans+=Long.parseLong(""+nums[i]+nums[j]);i++;j--;}if(i==j)ans+=nums[i];return ans;} }

import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int[][] mergeArrays(int[][] nums1,int[][] nums2){TreeMap<Integer,Integer> m=new TreeMap<>();for(int[]x:nums1)m.merge(x[0],x[1],Integer::sum);for(int[]x:nums2)m.merge(x[0],x[1],Integer::sum);int[][]out=new int[m.size()][2];int i=0;for(var e:m.entrySet()){out[i][0]=e.getKey();out[i++][1]=e.getValue();}return out;} }

import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int[] leftRightDifference(int[] nums){int total=0,left=0;for(int x:nums)total+=x;int[]out=new int[nums.length];for(int i=0;i<nums.length;i++){total-=nums[i];out[i]=Math.abs(left-total);left+=nums[i];}return out;} }

import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int passThePillow(int n,int time){int q=time/(n-1),r=time%(n-1);return q%2==0?r+1:n-r;} }

title: Distribute Money to Maximum Children
statement: Give every child one dollar, then allocate extra groups of seven.
approach_name: Maximize children receiving eight dollars without anyone receiving four
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int distMoney(int money,int children){if(money<children)return -1;money-=children;int ans=Math.min(money/7,children);money-=ans*7;if(ans==children&&money>0)ans--;else if(children-ans==1&&money==3)ans--;return ans;} }

import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int kItemsWithMaximumSum(int numOnes,int numZeros,int numNegOnes,int k){return Math.min(k,numOnes)-Math.max(0,k-numOnes-numZeros);} }

title: Form Smallest Number From Two Digit Arrays
statement: Use the smallest common digit or the smallest two-digit combination.
approach_name: Use the smallest common digit or smallest two-digit arrangement
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int minNumber(int[] nums1,int[] nums2){boolean[]seen=new boolean[10];for(int x:nums1)seen[x]=true;int common=10;for(int x:nums2)if(seen[x])common=Math.min(common,x);if(common<10)return common;int a=Arrays.stream(nums1).min().getAsInt(),b=Arrays.stream(nums2).min().getAsInt();return Math.min(10*a+b,10*b+a);} }

code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public List<List<Integer>> findMatrix(int[] nums){List<List<Integer>> rows=new ArrayList<>();for(int x:nums){boolean placed=false;for(List<Integer> row:rows)if(!row.contains(x)){row.add(x);placed=true;break;}if(!placed){List<Integer>row=new ArrayList<>();row.add(x);rows.add(row);}}return rows;} }

title: Prime In Diagonal
statement: Check both diagonals for prime values.
approach_name: Find the largest prime on either matrix diagonal
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int diagonalPrime(int[][] nums){int n=nums.length,best=0;for(int i=0;i<n;i++){if(prime(nums[i][i]))best=Math.max(best,nums[i][i]);if(prime(nums[i][n-1-i]))best=Math.max(best,nums[i][n-1-i]);}return best;} private boolean prime(int x){if(x<2)return false;for(int d=2;d*d<=x;d++)if(x%d==0)return false;return true;} }
